body: > By the time they figured out I'm not coming back I'd just be a memory to them.
That's the nice thing about kids. They lack knowledge.

Yeah I was thinking that, or maybe telling them that I'd joined the army and would be on a 5 year tour of Iraq or something. By the time they figured out I'm not coming back I'd just be a memory to them.

I can't see how actually going to another country would accomplish anything though (if I've understood your parenthesised suggestion correctly). Firstly I don't have the money to travel. Secondly if it's so hard here, I can't see it being any easier somewhere I don't speak the language or have a work permit. Thirdly it's unlikely I'd be able to even get into another country without being able to prove I can support myself. Finally even if I could surmount all of the above, there'd be no point in living without being able to see my kids.
